reports.title: AMERICAN TOWER CORPORATION REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS

guidance.heading: FULL YEAR 2026 OUTLOOK
section: The Company’s outlook is based on the following average foreign currency exchange rates to 1.00 U.S. Dollar for October 27, 2026 through December 31, 2026: (a) 1,575 Argentinean Pesos; (b) 5.10 Brazilian Reais; (c) 1.39 Canadian Dollars; (d) 970 Chilean Pesos; (e) 3,240 Colombian Pesos; (f) 0.89 Euros; (g) 11.80 Ghanaian Cedis; (h) 136 Kenyan Shillings; (i) 18.10 Mexican Pesos; (j) 1,370 Nigerian Naira; (k) 5,810 Paraguayan Guarani; (l) 3.45 Peruvian Soles; (m) 16.50 South African Rand; (n) 4,020 Ugandan Shillings; and (o) 580 West African CFA Francs.

As a result of Data Centers segment outperformance, the Company is raising the midpoint of its full year 2026 outlook for property revenue by $55 million. The midpoint of Adjusted EBITDA is unchanged from the Company’s prior outlook. The Company is lowering the midpoints for net income and net income attributable to AMT common stockholders by $30 million and $30 million, respectively, primarily due to unrealized losses for equity securities. The Company is maintaining the prior outlook midpoint of AFFO attributable to AMT common stockholders and raising the midpoint of AFFO attributable to AMT common stockholders per share by $0.02, primarily due to capital allocation decisions.

Additional information pertaining to the impact of foreign currency and Secured Overnight Financing Rate fluctuations on the Company’s outlook has been provided in the supplemental disclosure package available on the Company’s website.
